Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary (June 10-20, 2024), here's what you'll need:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days at Waikiki and Kailua, snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Sunscreen (high SPF recommended for tropical sun)
- Hiking gear (sturdy shoes, hat, water bottle for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and North Shore road trip)
- Camera (to capture memories at Pearl Harbor, beaches, and cultural sites)
- Travel documents (ID, flight information, hotel confirmations)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Reef-safe sunscreen (required for snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Comfortable walking shoes (for Pearl Harbor and shopping)
- Formal casual attire (for the Luau at Polynesian Cultural Center)
- Spa-appropriate attire (for relaxation day)
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can also rent at Hanauma Bay)
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses and hat
